title: Recordkeeping.
bodyText: A copy of all pawn transactions shall be kept on the pawnshop premises and open to inspection by the proper authorities for a period of one year after the maturity date.
bodyHtml: [§445-134.17]  Recordkeeping.  A copy of all pawn transactions shall be kept on the pawnshop premises and open to inspection by the proper authorities for a period of one year after the maturity date. [L 1992, c 192, pt of §2]
